lines.text: You were near the cookies. Kind of sus.

data.define: Short for suspicious; used when something or someone seems odd.

example.text: You were near the cookies. Kind of sus.

misuse.text: Don't call your teacher 'sus' in class.

publish.title: What does "sus" mean?
publish.value: Sus = That seems suspicious. Example: "You were near the cookies. Kind of sus." (very casual English, US).
